# PEEK PRESSURE

> PEEK PRESSURE is a Bay Area cleaning company offering pressure washing for properties and auto detailing for vehicles across the San Francisco Bay Area.

## Business

- Name: PEEK PRESSURE
- Website: https://peekpressure.com/
- Phone: 415-689-8377
- Email: look@peekpressure.com
- Service type: Pressure washing and auto detailing
- Property types: Residential and commercial
- Quote pricing: Custom pricing after job details are reviewed; fixed service prices are not published.

## Services

### Auto Detailing

PEEK PRESSURE provides vehicle cleaning and detailing with interior and exterior service based on the vehicle, condition, materials, and requested scope. Specialized correction, coatings, restoration, or other work is not assumed unless explicitly confirmed.

### Driveway Pressure Washing

PEEK PRESSURE cleans residential concrete driveways and removes surface buildup and tough stains.

### Sidewalk and Walkway Pressure Washing

PEEK PRESSURE cleans sidewalks, walkways, entrances, and pedestrian areas.

### Commercial Pressure Washing

PEEK PRESSURE provides exterior cleaning for offices, retail properties, apartment properties, and other commercial properties. Recurring service can be requested.

## Service Area

PEEK PRESSURE currently services:

- San Francisco
- Oakland
- San Leandro
- Hayward
- Burlingame
- South San Francisco
- Daly City
- San Mateo
- Fremont
- San Jose

## Process

1. Customers provide the service location, service type, and basic job details.
2. Customers can optionally upload photos to help with quoting.
3. PEEK PRESSURE reviews the request and provides clear pricing before work begins.
4. PEEK PRESSURE performs the cleaning.
5. Customers receive before-and-after photos and completion notification when applicable.
